title: Today's delete refusal comes before the Delete Customer window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with no work orders, part sales, assets or contacts of its own.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, so customer B is both a default and a Bill To on a work order.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • A "Confirmation" window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete".

Step 3:

  • The delete is refused with "Company with a work order cannot be deleted."
  • No "Delete Customer" window opens.
  • Customer B is not deleted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-R8: “Today's delete refusals come first; the "Delete Customer" window shows only when being another customer's default is the only reason.”
  • S12-R7: “A customer that is the Bill To on any work order or part sale cannot be deleted, with today's message "Company with a work order cannot be deleted."”
